title: Cash Register (Cha-Ching)
blurb: Cha-ching: the mechanical bell of a till drawer opening, a sound most people now recognise from television rather than from any shop they have actually visited this decade. It has become the internet's universal signal for profit in all its forms — a good deal, a payday landing, a scheme coming quietly together. Streamers wire it to donation alerts. Editors fire it the moment anybody so much as mentions money. Satisfying, faintly greedy, and understood instantly in any language on earth without translation.
origin: The classic mechanical register bell, meme shorthand for profit.
